title: Nash Payoffs Are Individually Rational
body_html:
Nash Payoffs Are Individually Rational

In a finite strategic game, the payoff vector of any Nash equilibrium belongs to $R_1$, the set of feasible and individually rational payoffs.

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 4.10.1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Any Nash equilibrium belongs to R_1.
